description: This PHP class 'FormatWithCompetency' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to provide a method for formatting entity values related to employee language competencies, using a constant lookup array from the EmployeeLanguage entity.

classes.name: FormatWithCompetency
classes.description: A class that formats entity values into their competency descriptions using a static lookup array.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the competency description for the given entity value, or null if not found.
